research_documents.interpretation: URLs, study types and verification descriptions are maintained in sources.json. Original scenario/algebra/editorial synthesis is marked E01–E03 there. No complete local PDF archive exists in this production directory; this documentation update does not re-fetch or independently re-verify every paper.
research_documents.narration: content/narration.json is canonical. Draft and repair source files are retained history; review/audio-repairs-v1/merge-candidates.json identifies seven adopted local repairs, and review/audio-merged/completion.json records their completed merge.

audio.narration_method: Standalone scripts/speech.py requests configured Chatterbox service without creating a FrontierTechSN Task.
audio.repair_input: content/narration-repair*.json; adopted candidates explicitly listed in review/audio-repairs-v1/merge-candidates.json
audio.score_and_foley: Original procedural synthesis in scripts/soundtrack.py using NumPy/SciPy; no sampled music library or reference soundtrack. content/audio-cues.json supplies explicit movement cues.
audio.mix: scripts/mix_audio.py preserves natural speech speed, resamples to the mix rate, applies gain and ducks the music; mix-report.json contains sample peak/RMS, not a measured LUFS or true-peak certificate.
audio.review_boundaries: Provider identity/PCM integrity, unprompted ASR, timing and subjective listening are separate. No listening completion asserted here.
audio.loudness_measurement: scripts/measure_loudness.py writes BS.1770 integrated LUFS with pyloudnorm 0.1.1 and a 4x SciPy polyphase oversampled peak estimate. The peak estimate is not a certified true-peak result; subjective_listening_established remains false.
audio.canonical_transcript_adoption: Only33v2: canonical the tests included replaces source the test included as an explicit editorial decision referring to plural student assessments, without asserting added test waves. scripts/transcript_adoption.py binds original/canonical source SHA, unchanged WAV SHA and four preserved ASR runs. Original provider source and rejected evidence remain unchanged.

fonts.source: Pre-installed macOS supplemental fonts; not copied or redistributed in this production.
fonts.portability: Re-rendering without these fonts can change typography, wrapping and spacing.

reproducibility.stable_inputs: Retain these exact PNG/SVG bytes, source code, package-lock.json, canonical narration, final audio manifest and WAVs, final media/timeline.json, and explicit audio cues.
reproducibility.generation_limit: The original five cutout atlas prompts were not durably archived. V9 paper has a complete prompt file. Model output is not guaranteed repeatable; existing hashed bitmaps remain required.
reproducibility.local_outputs: Videos, audio, downloaded references, contact sheets and runtime evidence are local artifacts; generated media is not part of the source commit. Preserve a separate local/archive copy of required assets and provider evidence.
reproducibility.source_identity_tool: scripts/validate_production.py; read-only JSON report to stdout; does not approve visual quality, research truth or listening.
reproducibility.render_pipeline: scripts/render_film.py launches bounded 750-frame Node processes, records input hashes and chunk checkpoints, decodes every newly encoded chunk, and concatenates without re-encoding. Each encoder/concat call uses ffmpeg_gate.py.

dependencies.encoder: System FFmpeg with macOS h264_videotoolbox; exact binary version not captured by this documentation task.

reproducibility.packaging: scripts/package_delivery.py validates complete timeline/PCM/subtitle evidence, copies encoded picture packets into MP4 with English audio, emits independent English SRT and verifies packet SHA unchanged. No embedded subtitles in delivered MP4.
